sentences.text: Shri Naval Kishor Gupta - Public Prosecutor for respon

No.1/State.
 Order
Case diary is available.
2. This second application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C./483 of BNSS has been filed for grant of bail.

3. Applicant has been arrested on 19.07.2024 in connection with Crime No.159/2022, registered at Police Station Jamner, District Guna (M.P.) for offence under Sections 363, 366A, 376 (2) (N) of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.
4. The first application was withdrawn on 14.11.2024 in MCRC No.48617/2024.
5. Allegations are that applicant has committed rape on a minor girl aged about 16 years.
DNA report indicates that DNA profile of applicant was found in incriminating articles of prosecutrix.
It is not known as to whether NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:2683 2 MCRC-1953-2025 prosecutrix has been examined in trial or not.
6. Under the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of considered opinion that no case is made out for grant of bail.
Accordingly, this application fails and is hereby dismissed.
